people.name: Hepher
people.line: Son of Gilead, ancestor of the Hepherites.

people.name: Hoglah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh.

people.name: Mahlah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, who received an inheritance among her brothers.

people.name: Milcah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh.

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, granted inheritance rights

people.name: Zelophehad
people.line: Israelite whose daughters received his inheritance

translations.web: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.bsb: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons but only daughters. The names of his daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.kjv: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.asv: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
